description: This file defines a RealtimeService class that manages WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections for real-time communication. It includes features like connection management, subscription handling, automatic reconnections with exponential backoff, and JWT authorization. The class provides a unified interface to subscribe/unsubscribe to topics and receive messages, with fallback strategies if WebSocket connection fails.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: A helper class implementing exponential backoff with jitter for reconnection strategies.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main class providing WebSocket and SSE realtime communication with features like subscription management, auto-reconnect, and JWT authorization.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to create a RealtimeService instance with a provided TokenGetter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection; attempts WebSocket connection first, falls back to SSE if needed.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified topic/channel, handling WebSocket commands or reconnection to apply topic filters via SSE.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a topic/channel, updating subscription filters or triggering a reconnection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes current connections and stops reconnection attempts.
